Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::batch_scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/good1"#, r#"https://example.com/bad"#, r#"https://example.com/good2"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let result = batch_scrape(&engine, urls).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.completed_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.failed_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.total_count);
}
```
